question: Why did Q4 revenue for the platform fall 8% year-on-year?
hypotheses: H2: Company is pivoting to a different segment

evidence.description: No new logos in the roadmap-aligned ICP for two quarters (sales dashboard, B2)
CEO on earnings call: 'we are re-evaluating market fit' (transcript, A2)
Headcount flat; no reorg announced (LinkedIn headcount tracker, C3)
Two competitors reported +15% growth in the same segment (press releases, B2)
